name: GCP DNS legacy record set cleanup
__comment__: DEPRECATED: remove in v1.0.0. Record sets written before the GCP DNS data model migration hang off their zones but have no RESOURCE edge from a GCPProject, so the schema cleanup never reaches them. The legacy loader keyed them by name, so one node can be shared by zones in several projects.

statements.__comment__: Delete stale legacy record sets that only this project's zones reference.
statements.query: MATCH (:GCPProject{id: $PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPDNSZone)-[:HAS_RECORD]->(n:GCPRecordSet) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND NOT (n)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject) AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (n)<-[:HAS_RECORD]-(z:GCPDNSZone) WHERE NOT (z)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $PROJECT_ID}) } WITH DISTINCT n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE n

statements.__comment__: Detach this project's zones from stale legacy record sets that other zones still reference.
statements.query: MATCH (:GCPProject{id: $PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPDNSZone)-[r:HAS_RECORD]->(n:GCPRecordSet) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND NOT (n)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject) WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE r
